article.title: Flower size evolution in the Southwest Pacific

source_reported_validation.design: 30 species with floral data available online were randomly selected and measured in the herbarium collection; paired data types were compared with a Wilcoxon signed-rank test
source_reported_validation.source_claim: no significant difference between herbarium measurements and data obtained from other sources

article_data_availability_statement: Plant species lists, flower traits measured, and models used for the analysis are available in the supplementary materials of this article.

admissibility.reason: A paired location-shift test can reject or fail to reject systematic difference, but without the paired measurements or replicate/error variance it does not identify the reliability ratio required for errors-in-variables correction.

remaining_routes: unadvertised publisher/source deposit if one exists
institutional or project archive not linked in the article record
claim_boundary: The article establishes that a 30-species paired online-versus-herbarium validation was performed and reports its Wilcoxon statistic, but the public associated-data inventory does not advertise a separate paired-validation file and the current source-native audit has not recovered the 30 paired values. This narrows the source search; it does not prove that the values never existed or are unavailable from every author/institutional route.
